template_data.headline_html: Four certs. Four different competitive edges.

items.title: HUBZone
items.desc: Sole-source up to $4M (supplies) or $7M (services). Most businesses can't hit the 35% residency rule — the ones who do dominate their local market with almost no competition.

items.title: 8(a)
items.desc: Nine-year program, sole-source access at the agency's discretion. Built-in protected runway while you build past performance. The application is the hard part — not the program itself.

items.title: SDVOSB
items.desc: Veteran-owned. The VA alone awarded $5.7B to small businesses last quarter — one of the most active set-aside markets in federal. Source · USAspending.gov

items.title: WOSB / EDWOSB
items.desc: Active across 83 NAICS codes, strongest in professional services. EDWOSB opens an extra tier of set-asides if you meet the economic disadvantage threshold.
